primary_outcome_or_role: Qualifies: Table 2 is explicitly titled Primary and secondary outcomes and reports numerical primary CRP-change and seven-day outcomes.

primary_outcome_or_role: Qualifies: the article reports the primary trial's malaria infection outcome through 24 months numerically (Table 2).

title: Yoga Programme for Type 2 Diabetes Prevention (YOGA-DP) Among High-Risk People in India: A Multicenter Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial.
primary_outcome_or_role: Qualifies as a feasibility primary report under the MRC rule: the current feasibility study measures recruitment, follow-up, and intervention adherence and reports them numerically. It does not qualify on future definitive-trial clinical co-primary outcomes; HbA1c and other clinical effects remain exploratory.

title: Impact of a virtual antenatal intervention for improved diet and iron intake in Kapilvastu district, Nepal - the VALID randomized controlled trial.
primary_outcome_or_role: Qualifies: the article identifies the current VALID trial's primary outcome as IFA compliance and reports its primary analysis numerically (Tables 4–5).

primary_outcome_or_role: Qualifies: this is the primary Yathu Yathu report for knowledge of HIV status; the primary endpoint and trial results are reported numerically (Table pmed.1004203.t002).

title: Feasibility and acceptability of a multicomponent, group psychological intervention for adolescents with psychosocial distress in public schools of Pakistan: a feasibility cluster randomized controlled trial (cRCT).
primary_outcome_or_role: Qualifies as a feasibility primary report: the article's stated purpose is feasibility and acceptability, and it reports current-study participation/implementation feasibility numerically. PSC scores are not relied on as an efficacy result.
